Product Details: Groz Heavy Duty Digital Tyre Inflator Gauge | 3 in 1 Tyre Gauge | Inflates, Deflates and Measure | Accuracy: +/-1% | Pressure: Up to 300 PSI | TIG/D/12/N - Distributed/Packaged by Groz. Product Details: Having a low Tyre pressure would increase the wear and tear of your Tyres. We have a solution ! Designed not only to measure tyre pressures, Groz Heavy Duty Digital Tyre Inflator Gauge inflates and deflates tyres of cars and other light vehicles as and when required. Activate the tyre deflation via the deflation valve on the gun body which is made from Brass in order to prevent it from rust. A simple press of the valve will activate it and reduce pressure. For accuracy, we have ascertained that it is +/-1% accurate with the resolution of 0.1 PSI across the maximum pressure up to 300 PSI. It measures in 4 Units, i.e., PSI, Mpa, Bar, Kg-cm². Note: An Air pump/compressor is required to inflate tires.
